stem: 一家跨国金融机构(FI)发现涉及美国、德国和新加坡空壳公司的可疑交易,这些交易似乎是一起洗钱活动的一部分.德国金融情报机构(FIU)与美国金融犯罪执法网络(FinCEN)以及新加坡金融情报机构联合展开了调查.由于各国法律框架、数据隐私法和程序要求各不相同,调查面临诸多挑战.哪种方法最能促进这些司法管辖区内的监管机构和执法机构之间的合作,以确保调查取得成功？

options.A: 依靠各司法管辖区现有的法律框架和非正式沟通渠道
options.B: 聘请第三方咨询公司作为不同司法管辖区监管机构和执法机构之间的调解人
options.C: 将调查集中于反洗钱法律最为严格的司法管辖区进行,以简化流程并降低多司法管辖区协调的复杂性
options.D: 利用在国际金融犯罪调查领域具有公认专业知识的现有和新兴多边合作框架,以促进跨境合作

alias_hits.review_note: FinCEN is the abbreviation for Financial Crime Enforcement Network (a slightly non-standard but clearly referencing the same US agency); Chinese translation 金融犯罪执法网络 is standard. All refer to the same regulatory body.
FIU is the standard abbreviation for Financial Intelligence Unit; the Chinese variants refer to the same concept with minor translation differences.
jurisdictions is the plural form of jurisdiction; 地域 and 司法管辖区 are both used as Chinese translations for the same term.

alias_hits.review_note: Singular and plural forms of the same English term; both refer to '可疑交易'.
Both 'regulator' and 'regulatory body' refer to the same supervisory institution in the AML context, and map to '监管机构'.
LEA is the abbreviation for law enforcement agency/agencies; 'law enforcement' is commonly used as a metonym for the agencies and maps to the same Chinese term 执法机构.
'shell company' and 'shell corporation' are equivalent and interchangeable terms; both correspond to '壳公司'.
